name: Spirit AI Moz1
summary: Moz1 is a wheeled humanoid from Hangzhou's Spirit AI with a 26-DoF force-controlled body and two 7-DoF arms on an omnidirectional base. It runs the company's Spirit V1 vision-language-action model and is used in pilot work on CATL battery lines and JD.com retail sites.
highlights: Claims a 1:1 payload-to-weight ratio for its arms and whole-body STO safety with collision detection.
A Spirit AI robot supported zero-defect production of nearly 1,000 battery units at CATL's Zhongzhou base, per Gasgoo.
Shown at the 2025 World Robot Conference.
caveats: Wheeled base, not a legged humanoid.
Height, weight and price are not published by reliable sources.
